dmn_experiences.title: Edinburgh Gin Distillery at The Arches
dmn_experiences.summary: A working gin distillery in Edinburgh's Old Town, near the Royal Mile, offering guided Stillhouse tours and tastings alongside cocktail classes and a make-your-own-gin experience.
highlights: Classic Tour & Tasting through the Stillhouse with signature gins and paired mixers
Gin & chocolate tasting with hand-selected artisan chocolates
Mix & Muddle cocktail class on the rooftop bar
Make-your-own gin in the Gin Lab, bottled with a custom label
Old Town location a short walk from the Royal Mile

dmn_experiences.title: Pickering's Gin
dmn_experiences.summary: An independent hand-crafted gin distillery at Summerhall running cocktail masterclasses, a cheese-and-cocktail brunch and Scottish tasting experiences.
highlights: Cocktail Craft Masterclass making three cocktails
The Scottish Explorer with local cheese, charcuterie and spirit pairings
Set in the historic Summerhall arts venue

dmn_experiences.title: Whisky and Cheese Tastings at Whiski Rooms
dmn_experiences.summary: An hour-long tasting at Whiski Rooms on the Mound, pairing four single malt whiskies with four cheeses from a local cheesemonger.
highlights: Four single malt whiskies paired with four cheeses
Cheeses sourced from a local cheesemonger
Learn how to match whisky with food and flavours
